item.text: A valid PostgreSQL URL passes the check; the injected `DATABASE_URL` does not. The server never uses that variable or opens a database connection, and it currently exits after printing “listening.” I’m removing the unused startup dependency and making the process actually listen on port 3000.

item.text:
`npm start` crashed because startup rejected the shared `DATABASE_URL`, even though the app never uses a database. It also printed “listening” without opening a port.

I removed that unused check, made the server listen on port 3000, and updated `npm run doctor` so it no longer prints environment variables. Verified that `npm start` stays running and `/health` returns HTTP 200. The shared database URL will need correcting if database access is added later.
